rationale: The middle record carries the same headline and no standfirst, so it agrees with both of the others taken one at a time. The outer two flatly contradict each other. A stage that checks only the two ends of an edge would chain all three into one story that says profit both rose and fell; a stage that checks the whole prospective cluster attaches the sparse record to the endpoint it reached first and refuses the contradicting one.
